title: EventBus nested cross-callback mutation snapshot recovery contract

contract.nested_cross_callback_mutation: A callback can mutate another callback, which can independently mutate a third callback during the same active EventBus.emit() cycle
contract.snapshot_delivery: Every listener present at the start of the broadcast receives the active event exactly once
contract.nested_reregister_isolation: Listeners re-registered at any nesting level do not receive the active broadcast a second time
contract.single_owner_entries: Each recovered owner has exactly one listener entry
contract.duplicate_owner_prevention: Nested cross-callback mutations do not create duplicate owner entries
contract.registry_order_integrity: Removed and re-registered listeners are appended in mutation order
contract.post_recovery_delivery_once: Subsequent broadcasts deliver exactly once to every currently registered listener
contract.emit_continuity: EventBus.emit() remains successful before and after nested recovery
contract.source_metadata: Delivered events preserve the plugin_id supplied to emit() as source metadata
contract.permission_enforcement: EventBus registration, unregister, and emit operations require the events permission
